## Summary

I implemented the audit-on-create requirement in `OwnerRestControllerV1` (the controller handling `POST /api/owners`):

- **Added an `AUDIT` logger** — a `Logger` obtained via `LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT")`, the dedicated logger name the spec and `AuditLogCapture` test helper expect.
- **Emitted the audit line after a successful save** in `addOwner`, right after `saveOwner(owner)` so the owner has its generated id, `customerCode` and resolved `registrationDate`:

```java
AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}",
    owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
```

The line carries all three required values (owner id, `customerCode`, `registrationDate`). The new `AcceptanceTest.coreLogsAuditOnCreate` passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
